description: Compare a branch (the source) against the token's base branch (the target): returns the changed, added and deleted keys, each with the differing per-language source/target values, plus a summary of counts. The branch must be in the token's allowed set. Use this to see exactly what a branch would bring into the base before merging. For a capped, human-oriented review view, use review_changes instead.

branch.description: The branch to compare against the base (the source of the diff).

name: compare_with_base
title: Compare Branch With Base
